task.candidate_surface: R03 candidate_payload with canonical records and explicit primitive operations; no answer, latent_program, seed, split, or provenance fields

decoding.output_contract: one JSON array of result records and no surrounding prose

scoring.normalization: canonical JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators
scoring.exact_match: parsed prediction equals the independent reference answer; invalid JSON and missing output are incorrect

resources.resource_capture: wall time, peak VRAM, peak RAM, model identity, artifact hashes, failures

boundaries.development: descriptive only; no prompt, decoder, scorer, or library changes after final manifest generation
boundaries.final: held out until the frozen run; no final answers used for tuning
